<!-- Generated by scripts/build_help.py from Puzzle's own data: don't edit. -->


Problems show in the Problems tab and the Advisor before a run; refusals and warnings name their code, which agents read too.

<!-- key: problem:added_mass, error:added_mass -->
### added_mass

Mass scaling added over 5 % of the mass (ADR 0085).

<!-- key: problem:ambiguous, error:ambiguous -->
### ambiguous

The name matches several objects; use the id.

<!-- key: problem:budget_exceeded, error:budget_exceeded -->
### budget_exceeded

The agent's compute budget is spent.

<!-- key: problem:busy, error:busy -->
### busy

Another client holds the project lock.

<!-- key: problem:confirmation_required, error:confirmation_required -->
### confirmation_required

The change needs a further confirmation.

<!-- key: problem:contact_far, error:contact_far -->
### contact_far

A contact's faces start further apart than its search distance.

<!-- key: problem:contact_nonconforming, error:contact_nonconforming -->
### contact_nonconforming

A curved source face meets its target along a line or at a point (a cylinder or ball on a plate), which Code_Aster's contact can't pair.

<!-- key: problem:contact_only_hold, error:contact_only_hold -->
### contact_only_hold

A body is held only through sliding contact: weak springs hold it until the contact closes (ADR 0080).

<!-- key: problem:contact_overhang, error:contact_overhang -->
### contact_overhang

A contact's source face reaches past the edge of its target.

<!-- key: problem:contact_shared_outline, error:contact_shared_outline -->
### contact_shared_outline

A contact's two faces have the same outline, where Code_Aster's 3D friction fails.

<!-- key: problem:contact_slave_bolted, error:contact_slave_bolted -->
### contact_slave_bolted

A contact's source face shares nodes with bolt ends.

<!-- key: problem:contact_slave_held, error:contact_slave_held -->
### contact_slave_held

Nodes of a contact's source face are also held, or the source of another contact.

<!-- key: problem:duplicate_solver, error:duplicate_solver -->
### duplicate_solver

A shoot-out lists the same solver twice.

<!-- key: problem:energy_error, error:energy_error -->
### energy_error

An explicit run's energy balance off by more than 5 % (ADR 0085).

<!-- key: problem:exists, error:exists -->
### exists

The folder or file is already there.

<!-- key: problem:explicit_cost, error:explicit_cost -->
### explicit_cost

A long explicit run, or one element setting its time step (ADR 0085).

<!-- key: problem:export_failed, error:export_failed -->
### export_failed

A file could not be written.

<!-- key: problem:field_axis, error:field_axis -->
### field_axis

An imported field's axis (time or frequency) doesn't fit the step it is in.

<!-- key: problem:foreign_local_geometry, error:foreign_local_geometry -->
### foreign_local_geometry

A component uses geometry local to another component.

<!-- key: problem:free_body, error:free_body -->
### free_body

A body is neither held nor joined to a held body.

<!-- key: problem:host_unreachable, error:host_unreachable -->
### host_unreachable

Ssh could not reach the remote host, or lost it (ADR 0021).

<!-- key: problem:hourglass, error:hourglass -->
### hourglass

Hourglass energy over 10 % of the internal energy (ADR 0085).

<!-- key: problem:incomplete_material, error:incomplete_material -->
### incomplete_material

A material lacks a property the study needs.

<!-- key: problem:inconsistent, error:inconsistent -->
### inconsistent

The project fails a consistency check.

<!-- key: problem:invalid, error:invalid -->
### invalid

The value does not fit the schema.

<!-- key: problem:invalid_archive, error:invalid_archive -->
### invalid_archive

A project archive damaged, unsafe or from a newer Puzzle (ADR 0061).

<!-- key: problem:invalid_input, error:invalid_input -->
### invalid_input

The study cannot be written for this solver.

<!-- key: problem:job_lost, error:job_lost -->
### job_lost

The scheduler ended the job itself (a node failure, preemption, a cancel from outside Puzzle) or its outcome is unknown (ADR 0021).

<!-- key: problem:large_strain, error:large_strain -->
### large_strain

Large-deflection strains past 5 % on an elastic material (ADR 0082).

<!-- key: problem:mesh_failed, error:mesh_failed -->
### mesh_failed

Meshing failed.

<!-- key: problem:missing_input, error:missing_input -->
### missing_input

An operator's input is not chosen or wired yet.

<!-- key: problem:missing_physics, error:missing_physics -->
### missing_physics

A study solves a physics its component doesn't have.

<!-- key: problem:missing_reference, error:missing_reference -->
### missing_reference

An object refers to another that no longer exists.

<!-- key: problem:negative_radius, error:negative_radius -->
### negative_radius

An axisymmetric model must lie at x >= 0 (Y is the axis).

<!-- key: problem:no_material, error:no_material -->
### no_material

A part has no material assigned.

<!-- key: problem:not_allowed, error:not_allowed -->
### not_allowed

The actor's autonomy level does not permit this.

<!-- key: problem:not_found, error:not_found -->
### not_found

No object (or field) by that name or id.

<!-- key: problem:not_planar, error:not_planar -->
### not_planar

A 2D model's faces must lie in the XY plane at z = 0.

<!-- key: problem:not_undoable, error:not_undoable -->
### not_undoable

The command cannot be undone.

<!-- key: problem:operator_input, error:operator_input -->
### operator_input

An operator's required input isn't wired.

<!-- key: problem:out_of_memory, error:out_of_memory -->
### out_of_memory

The remote host's scheduler stopped the job for using too much memory.

<!-- key: problem:queue_rejected, error:queue_rejected -->
### queue_rejected

The remote host's scheduler refused the job (ADR 0021).

<!-- key: problem:script_failed, error:script_failed -->
### script_failed

A script operator raised an error, or left no result (ADR 0062).

<!-- key: problem:solver_failed, error:solver_failed -->
### solver_failed

The solver ran but failed.

<!-- key: problem:stale_store, error:stale_store -->
### stale_store

The results store has an older format; delete it to rebuild.

<!-- key: problem:stopped, error:stopped -->
### stopped

The run was stopped before it finished.

<!-- key: problem:suppressed, error:suppressed -->
### suppressed

Every part of the study's component is suppressed: nothing to solve.

<!-- key: problem:sweep_order, error:sweep_order -->
### sweep_order

A study's sweep steps come after its solve steps: they must come first.

<!-- key: problem:thread_radii, error:thread_radii -->
### thread_radii

A threaded contact's two cylinders are not one radius (ADR 0076).

<!-- key: problem:timeout, error:timeout -->
### timeout

It ran past its time limit and was stopped.

<!-- key: problem:transfer_failed, error:transfer_failed -->
### transfer_failed

Copying a case to or from the remote host failed (ADR 0021).

<!-- key: problem:unconstrained, error:unconstrained -->
### unconstrained

A solid-mechanics study on a component with no fixed or displacement condition: it would move as a rigid body.

<!-- key: problem:unknown_host, error:unknown_host -->
### unknown_host

No remote host by that name in your hosts.toml (ADR 0021).

<!-- key: problem:unknown_parameter, error:unknown_parameter -->
### unknown_parameter

A sweep varies a parameter the project doesn't define.

<!-- key: problem:unknown_selection, error:unknown_selection -->
### unknown_selection

A component uses a selection its geometry doesn't have.

<!-- key: problem:unpinned_transfer, error:unpinned_transfer -->
### unpinned_transfer

A transfer from a swept study doesn't say which point it takes (its source_point).

<!-- key: problem:unsupported, error:unsupported -->
### unsupported

Not implemented yet.

<!-- key: problem:untrusted, error:untrusted -->
### untrusted

The project is not trusted: its scripts and equations don't run (ADR 0062).

<!-- key: problem:walltime_exceeded, error:walltime_exceeded -->
### walltime_exceeded

The job ran past its walltime on the remote host (ADR 0021).

<!-- key: problem:weak_springs, error:weak_springs -->
### weak_springs

Weak springs were added to a body held only by sliding contact (ADR 0080).

<!-- key: problem:weak_springs_carry, error:weak_springs_carry -->
### weak_springs_carry

A body's weak springs carry its load: it never seated (ADR 0080).
